evidence_kind: Hand-authored contract proposal; expected fixture results are typed literals cross-checked by a stdlib-only scratch evaluator that imports nothing from the equity packages. No library, test or worker was run.

header_rules.complete_set: all seven for the homogeneous producer; no subset, no combination

selection_schema.clock_dimensions: nonempty strictly ascending subset of [quoting, ssr, trading]
selection_schema.max_age_ns: null or nonnegative int64; null means no event-age expiry

state_policy.precedence: permutation of [active, halted, closed], highest precedence first; no default

roles.interval: finite [start,end); applicable iff start<=seed original effective time and C<=end

slot_rule: exactly five slots in this order, each a CanonicalBatch or None; None is missing delivery, a present zero-row batch is present-empty
quality_status_rule: missing_input if any legacy reason in {absent_input, unknown_availability, future_knowledge, ineligible}; else incomplete_coverage if governed_gap; empty population: not_applicable/empty_universe

fixture_notation.slots: expanded literal rows [reference_id, fact_kind, effective_start_ns, effective_end_ns, text, known_at_ns]; B() is unpadded base64url
fixture_notation.availability: market_cutoff_ns=C, knowledge_cutoff_ns=K, mode known_at unless stated
fixture_notation.policy: fixture precedence orders is synthetic test data, not a recommended order
fixture_notation.evidence: expected witness (output, publisher, dimension) hand-asserted per fixture and cross-checked by the scratch evaluator

coordinator_decisions.text: Accepted: counts are null unless every expected publisher is known. Partial information is carried by aggregate_state/aggregate_reason and by quality coverage (expected = N, observed = number of known publishers). Partial-count outputs may be added only by a later reviewed amendment.
Accepted: trading = active; non-trading = halted, closed; quoting_any positive = quoting enabled; restriction_any positive = ssr on.

Accepted: the policy is caller-supplied with no default order. policy_id comes from a closed reviewed vocabulary declared in this contract: exactly [venue_precedence_v1]; policy_version exactly [1]. A policy may map to a distinct aggregate label (for example mixed) only if that label is added to this closed vocabulary by amendment; v1 declares none, so aggregate_state is one of active, halted, closed.
Accepted: no calendar slot or calendar context (calendar null).
Accepted: one epoch shared by all publishers.

Accepted for v1: outputs decided by one witness report coverage 1/1. Observable elsewhere: the expected-population size N is the row count and coverage of the bound venue_population input in result metadata, and equals expected on every counts, aggregate_state and non-witness quality row; the unknown-publisher count is observable as expected minus observed on known_trading_count and known_nontrading_count (trading dimension) when they are unavailable. For quoting_any, restriction_any and latest_event_ns decided by one witness, and for aggregate_state decided by dominance, the unknown count is not on the output: the canonical EvidenceRow has fixed fields that cannot carry counts, and no canonical change is proposed. This is a stated v1 limitation; a reviewed amendment may add outputs. The independent reviewer should confirm.
Accepted: empty complete population gives not_applicable/empty_universe with null values.
Accepted: latest_event_ns is included, with the clock population, stale-clock, expired-validity and C-1 saturation rules above.
Accepted: seeds are REFERENCE rows (slot venue_seed); new mapping version ef1-venue-map1 and the new reference_id and fact_kind grammars.

Accepted: unit strings publishers, bool and utc_ns, and the enlarged header ledger (45 plus 7 headers), are introduced by an additive EF1-only amendment with matching worker admission and version handling. The frozen CONTRACT.json bytes do not change.
Accepted: aggregate_reason labels and precedence form a closed new vocabulary.
Accepted: a single max_age_ns for all dimensions.
Accepted: a repeated publisher id within one population revision is rejected DUPLICATE; membership history needs distinct revisions.
Finalized as proposed: invalid_config for context and policy violations, invalid_schema for slot shape and closed vocabularies.
Accepted: instrument/session binding is the target entity only.

Explicit item for the independent reviewer: validate against the QualityRow rules that not_applicable with expected = observed = 0 (empty population) and expected = null with observed = 0 (unavailable population) are admissible. Not verified here.
